notes: Reached via plain HTTPS fetch (route 1 per prior notes), no WAF. robots.txt has no Claude/anthropic-specific disallow; it does disallow /*search?* so the site's own search UI was not used - relied on the homepage mega-menu JSON (editorialContent.content.nav, all ~15 department tabs enumerated) plus https://www.dunelm.com/sitemap/category-sitemap.xml (7295 lines) grepped for best/clearance/trend/popular/favourite/top-sell terms, which is thorough per brief SS4 allowance. Found and validated 2 genuine Bestsellers-type PLPs: 'Trending Products' (sitewide, target-term match, real facet/filter PLP, nav label verbatim 'Trending Products' under the New & Inspiration tab) and 'Five Star Furniture Favourites' (Furniture-department-scoped curated/rated selection, not in the mega-menu but present in category-sitemap.xml with its own H1/breadcrumb and full facet PLP template; matches the brief's 'Customer Favorites' target-term family - a judgment call, recorded with rationale here rather than a flag since the page itself unambiguously is a listing and unambiguously names itself a favourites/best-of selection). Investigated and EXCLUDED as false positives: 'Trending Now' nav tile -> /category/seasonal/cool-sleep (a seasonal bedding campaign page reusing the word Trending, not a popularity listing); 'Popular Features' nav tile -> /category/lighting (a plain category shortcut, not a popularity listing); 'Special Buys' (/category/special-buys, 843 products, meta description 'exceptional products at outstanding prices' - a discount/promo concept, not bestseller/popularity); 'Shop All Offers' (/category/offers/all-offers, umbrella discounts roll-up). No literal 'Bestsellers'/'Best Sellers'/'Most Popular'/'Customer Favourites' (site-wide) URL exists in the sitemap or mega-menu beyond the two rows kept. Both counts are cross-verified: Trending Products via the rendered 'ResultListHeader' total (121 results, template B); Five Star Furniture Favourites via totalProducts JSON in the shell-ssr-data matching the rendered '188 results' text on-page (template A) - same dual-template cross-check method the prior Home-Decor pass used for this company.
